profile.headline: Software Engineer at Parsons Corporation.
profile.summary: I am a Full Stack Web Developer, experienced with React, Redux, Node.js, SQL, HTML, CSS, Spring Boot and Java.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Develop Web applications for satellite and ground stations.
* Work as full-stack developer.
* Develop frontend using React, Redux, Vite, HTML, CSS, and Typescript / Javascript.
* Develop backend using Spring Boot, Java, Kotlin, Postgresql, etc.
* Utilize Kubernetes for a local development environment.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · React · HTML · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · SASS · Javascript · TypeScript · vite · Single Page Applications · REST APIs · WebSocket · Spring Boot · Java · Kotlin · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Develop Frontend using React, Redux, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Bootstrap, and etc.
* Develop Backend Rest API server using Java, Spring Boot, and Oracle.
* Setup Local development environment using Docker.
* Integrate Web Application with Natural Language Processing Stack.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Develop Frontend using React, Apollo Client, Redux, HTML, CSS, SCSS, and etc.
* Develop Backend Rest API / GraphQL server using Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.
* Setup Local development environment using Docker.
* Integrate Web Application with Natural Language Processing Stack.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
* Create Frontend using React
* Create Backend using AWS API Gateway and Lambda with Node.js
* setup and test various AWS environment using AWS CDK

positions.title: Full Stack Javascript Developer
positions.description:
* Maintain and develop frontend applications using React, Javascript, Webpack, Babel, HTML, CSS and etc. 
* Maintain and develop backend API servers (microservice architecture) using Node.js, Restify.js, Postgresql, and etc.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Maintain and develop frontend applications using React, Redux, MobX, Javascript, Node.js, Docker, HTML, CSS, SCSS, and various NPM modules.
* Deploy frontend codes using CI/CD Pipeline with Jenkins, Amazon AWS.
* Perform unit testing using Jest.

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
* Transform UI Mockups to React components using React, Redux, CSS, SCSS, D3, and various NPM libraries.
* Integrate React Single Page Application with Backend Node.js API server using Axios library.
* Deploy frontend codes using CI/CD Pipeline with Jenkins, Amazon AWS, and various Capital One's Internal application.
* Perform unit test and end to end testing using Jest, Enzyme, and Puppeteer.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
*Transform Sketch Mockups to React components using bootstrap 4, SASS, React, Redux, and various libraries.
* Create temporary API server using Node.js for testing with frontend code.
* Integrate the React Single Page Application with Backend API server.
* Setup Jenkins server for frontend CI/CD. Deploy frontend React codes to Amazon S3 using Jenkins CI/CD server.
* Improve React code to comply with 508 compliance

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
* Transform design to HTML5 template using bootstrap 4, CSS
* Convert HTML templates to React.js.
* Develop backend REST API server or configure backend server such as WordPress API.
* Deploy servers on the Amazon AWS.
* Test Prototype web application.

positions.title: Web Developer and Amazon AWS Administrator
positions.description:
* Redeveloping the legacy web accounting application to open source technology including Laravel, React, Amazon RDS MariaDB 10.x, and Amazon AWS EC2.
* Manage Cisco Network product, Ubiquiti UNIFI access point, local VM servers and IT Devices such as Office Windows PCs.
* Will reduce server hosting payment up to $10,000/year and enhance system scalability and flexibility once redeveloping project is complete compared to legacy one

company.name: Body & Brain Yoga & Health Centers, Inc.

positions.title: Server and Network Administrator
positions.description:
* Managed Local VM server, IT Devices, Cisco network product and Ubiquiti UNIFI AP.
* Operated VOIP System - Asterisk based Elastix 2.x server and IP Phones.
* Saved money and reduced efforts of maintenance up to 50% by replacing existing network devices with Cisco products, Unifi APs and Open source VOIP system.

positions.title: System and Network Administrator
positions.description:
* Maintained local Linux file server and IT devices such as Network Printer, Office Window PCs.
* Configured and managed Cisco network product and network devices including PTP wireless network.
* Improved Internet connection reliability and speed up to 400% faster by upgrading PTP devices with a new product.
